records.issue_text: Off-by-one pagination in admin-group.js.es6 totalPages: Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 produces a phantom empty page when user_count divides evenly by limit; should be Math.ceil(user_count / limit)
records.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1` (when `user_count != 0`). If `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 100/50), this yields one extra page (3 instead of 2), creating a phantom empty last page. Using `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)` (and handling 0) would avoid the off-by-one.
